scope: PARTIAL Week11: 5 of 13 events have captured player prices: 4 across all six standard categories, JAX-NYG across four (no receiving yards/receptions observed). Remaining 8 event inventories had no targeted standard quotes observed, including TEN-DAL with last-TD-scorer only. The other 12 event inventories were checked Nov17 10:51-11:02 CT; IND-HOU retains its 09:41-09:44 CT capture. These are dated snapshots, not continuous or full-slate six-category coverage.
availability_note: Book listing and roster membership are not game clearance. Model figures retain their own older source times and have no new injury/workload adjustment. Book prices are comparisons only; no betting edge or current TN offer claimed.
